title: Safety gate (FIN-03 prerequisites): static authorization gate, ledger invariant suite, findings
statusReason: The DB-free half is verified here (route-security 9/9, domain 11/11, boundary scan PASS, mutation-tested). The 11-test ledger invariant suite and the runner/package changes could not be executed: this environment has no Postgres, pnpm or node_modules. HTTP-level authenticated tests were not written. WP-1 is therefore split: 1a written (this record), 1b open.

commands.command: mutation tests on a throwaway copy of the route files
commands.result: Caught: requireAuth removed from a route; owner read from req.body (5 syntactic forms incl. destructuring); db call added to a report route; new direct-db route (ratchet); run-now fixed (ratchet flips). Initial regex missed `(req as any).body.userId` and destructuring; tightened and re-verified.
